operations.summary: Authenticate and apply one raw payment-provider callback
operations.description: No bearer identity is accepted as proof. All four callback headers must each have exactly one non-empty value without surrounding whitespace. The timestamp is canonical Unix seconds within the configured freshness window. The HMAC-SHA256 input is eleven newline-separated values in this order: cdnca.package-commerce.provider-callback.v1, the provider path value, provider_account_id, key ID, timestamp, external_event_id, external_payment_id, event_kind, canonical decimal amount_minor, currency, and the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the exact raw body. X-CDNCA-Callback-Signature is v1= followed by the canonical base64url-no-padding encoding of the 32-byte HMAC. Verification binds the provider, account, and key before the normalized callback reaches the commerce core. Exact and concurrent signed retries pass authentication; durable external_event_id plus raw payload SHA-256 idempotency returns the committed replay, while a changed payload returns provider_event_conflict. Raw payloads, credentials, keyring contents, and secrets are never returned by this endpoint.

params.name: X-CDNCA-Callback-Version
params.description: Exactly one value selecting callback signature version 1.

params.name: X-CDNCA-Callback-Key-ID
params.description: Exactly one configured key identifier bound to the provider and provider account.

params.name: X-CDNCA-Callback-Timestamp
params.description: Exactly one canonical base-10 Unix-seconds value that fits signed int64.

params.name: X-CDNCA-Callback-Signature
params.description: Exactly one v1= prefixed canonical base64url-no-padding encoding of the 32-byte HMAC-SHA256.

responses.description: Normalized provider event processed or replayed.

fields.name: fulfillment
fields.description: Sanitized fulfillment reference. Billing transaction and balance-hold IDs are intentionally not exposed. Package fulfillment has a non-zero subscription_id plus both positive revisions and no traffic_grant_id; traffic fulfillment has a non-zero traffic_grant_id and no subscription fields. Before returning a command response, the implementation verifies the exact fulfillment, order, tenant, owner, subscription/grant IDs, and revisions against committed commerce facts. A mismatch is rejected.
